seoTitle: How to Add a Promotional or Email Popup on Squarespace
metaDescription: Set up a promotional popup on Squarespace to announce offers or collect email signups, using the built-in Promotional Popup feature.
intro: A well-placed popup can grab attention for a sale, announce an offer, or grow your email list without much setup. This guide covers turning on Squarespace's Promotional Popup feature, choosing a layout, and customizing the content for your goal.

steps.heading: Log in and open your dashboard
steps.body: Sign in at squarespace.com, using Continue with Google if linked, then open your site's backend.

steps.heading: Find the Promotional Popup feature
steps.body: Go to Pages in the left-hand menu, scroll to Website Tools, and click on Promotional Popup.

steps.heading: Enable the popup
steps.body: Flip the toggle switch to activate the popup, then click Save to apply the change.

steps.heading: Choose a layout
steps.body: Click Change Layout and select the popup style that fits your site's design and purpose.

steps.heading: Customize content and save
steps.body: Edit the popup message, add an email field for newsletter signups or a call-to-action, then click Save again to make it live.

faq.question: Where do I find the popup settings on Squarespace?
faq.answer: Go to Pages, scroll to the Website Tools section, and click Promotional Popup.

faq.question: Can I use the popup to collect email signups?
faq.answer: Yes, you can add an email field in the popup content editor to build a newsletter or email list.

faq.question: How many popup layouts can I choose from?
faq.answer: Squarespace offers several layout options you can browse and select through the Change Layout button.

faq.question: Will popups annoy my visitors?
faq.answer: A well-timed, clear popup can drive conversions, but showing too many or too often can turn visitors away, so use them thoughtfully.
